items.headline: Council agenda listed City Attorney appointment in closed session
items.summary: The October 27 City Council agenda listed a 5:15 p.m. closed session on a public employee appointment for the City Attorney position. It also listed a labor-negotiator conference covering the City Attorney, who is an unrepresented employee.

items.headline: Council agenda: LinkedIn deal, San Antonio Road housing bonds, SR 237 interchange
items.summary: The October 27 City Council agenda listed a second reading of an amendment to the LinkedIn development agreement covering 700-810 East Middlefield Road and 1100-1200 Maude Avenue. It also listed tax-exempt bond financing for multi-family housing at 334 San Antonio Road, a design concept for the State Route 237/Middlefield Road interchange improvements, and adoption of a Public Art Strategy.

items.headline: Campbell agenda lists 40-townhome project on W. Campbell Avenue
items.summary: The October 27 Planning Commission agenda listed a public hearing on Madrone Ventures' proposal for 40 townhomes in six three-story buildings at 1380 & 1400 W. Campbell Avenue, including removal of existing street trees along the frontage. Staff recommended approval of the permit and subdivision map. Under the Housing Crisis Act, the review is limited to rules in effect when the preliminary application was filed on May 19, 2025.

items.headline: October 27 agenda listed Campbell Home Depot permit compliance review
items.summary: The October 27 Planning Commission agenda listed a compliance review of the Home Depot at 480 E. Hamilton Avenue and Salmar Avenue. Staff's recommended action was to receive a report documenting substantial compliance with the permit conditions of approval.

items.headline: October 26 agenda listed three-condo plan on Hawthorn Avenue
items.summary: The October 26 Planning Commission study session agenda listed a proposal at 536 Hawthorn Avenue to demolish a 1,360 square foot duplex on a 0.29-acre R-3 lot and build three townhome-style condominiums in one two-story building. It also listed a tentative parcel map to split the lot into three.

items.headline: Citywide residential parking rules rewrite: continuance to November 9 requested
items.summary: The October 26 Planning Commission agenda listed a proposed ordinance to repeal and replace Sunnyvale's zoning Chapter 19.46 on parking. It would also amend the Downtown, Lawrence Station, and El Camino Real specific plan chapters and the Dual Urban Opportunity Housing chapter. Staff requested a continuance to November 9, 2026.

items.headline: October 20 agenda listed Pruneyard deadline extension request to 2031
items.summary: The October 20 City Council agenda listed a public hearing on the Pruneyard Center Association's request to extend the Phase 3 and 4 deadlines and the related parcel map expiration to December 31, 2031. Those phases include a five-story office building, parking structure expansions and additional commercial buildings at S. Bascom Ave and E. Campbell Ave. The Planning Commission recommended that the council approve the amendment and the map extension.
